text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As mid-autumn approached and bare trees began to catch the eye—
Kyoto Racecourse was filled with tremendous, roaring excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—She's definitely going for the Triple Tiara!
With this, it's gotta be the Triple Tiara!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It'd be amazing if someone stopped her, but...
with all due respect, it's Almond Eye!
The birth of the fifth Triple Tiara Umamusume in history!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, the other girls were amazing too, but...!
Almond Eye really is on another level...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She probably won't lose to her Tiara peers anymore.
The question now is whether she can hold her own against the Classic Triple Crown contenders...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh,
oooooooh~~!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Amazing! I can feel everyone's hearts pounding like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's cheering for Ai!
Bu is too! But I wanna cheer for Lala, too!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Or rather! Everyone's my friend,
so I want all of them to do their best!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. But to be honest... I have pretty high hopes for Ai-chan, too.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There's a mysterious light in her eyes.
Like she's going to show us something truly amazing—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can't wait! What kind of race...
will you show us?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Even the fans who couldn't make it to the track... no,
every single race fan out there must be eagerly anticipating
what is about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: If possible, I would love to witness this historic feat with my own eyes! I am truly looking forward to today's race!
choice_data_list: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Geez, why are you the one getting all stiff?
I'm the one who's running, aren't I?”
choice_data_list: The expectations were just far too high...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Did that gross you out?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara, huh...
I do think it's a wonderful achievement, though."
choice_data_list: Still, it's not what you really want.
Still, that's not what you truly want.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right.
I am...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —And you?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What is it that you desire?
choice_data_list: ...Of course, it's your victory.
...Of course, it's your victory.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Right.
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let us savor that joy together.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As you are now,
I'm sure you can feel it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――The same ultimate feeling that I have!
choice_data_list: Ai...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Now then! In just a few dozen minutes, your trainee will achieve the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How exactly
will you send me off, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Be sure to let me share that same joy
Be sure to let me share that same joy, okay?
I'll shout loud enough for it to reach you!
I'll shout loud enough for it to reach you!
Our hearts are one all the way to the finish line.
Our hearts are one all the way to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How exactly
will you send me off, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Be sure to let me share that same joy
Be sure to let me share that same joy, okay?
I'll shout loud enough for it to reach you!
I'll shout loud enough for it to reach you!
Our hearts are one all the way to the finish line.
Our hearts are one all the way to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want it so, so badly myself...
I can't stand it! I'm definitely not giving it up!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it, you hear!
I'm really looking forward to it, okay!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
――I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, really?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume have great hearing, you know!
Let your voice reach me so clearly it feels like you're right by my side!
choice_data_list: Leave it to me, I'll be waiting at the goal!
Leave it to me—I'll be waiting at the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
――I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Then you will
most certainly be smiling!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because crossing the finish line in first place,
that very moment—it's truly wonderful!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you!
I'm counting on you, okay!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
――I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...!
No way, I can hear them all the way out here...
The cheers for Ai-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine, I'm fine, I'm fine.
I can win, I can win, I can win...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, Lala...――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Lala... somehow looks so radiant and sparkling—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Ai-san.
Thanks for comin' by to cheer me on right to the very end."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You were always like that.
Even though you were the victor, you always
challenged me just the same...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—And that pissed me off
something fierce!!”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Always so composed, yet not boasting in the slightest... You made me feel like I could never match you, time and time again...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That was humiliating!! But... even I have things I refuse to back down on anymore!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's pathetic, even if it's reckless...!
I wanna become—the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Lala...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're a monster on a whole other level.
The whole world knows it. That's why――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Works for me! Besides, takin' down a monster's gonna get way more attention anyway, right?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's just a single petal, so what?! Even if it's just one petal, I'll definitely grab hold of it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, fufufu.
Fufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Lala! My heart is racing!
I knew it was the right choice to aim to be like you...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for laying it all bare!
I understand your feelings completely!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, today...
I will bloom in full glory!”
